summary: Security testing for M2 (HttpOnly Cookie Auth) and M4 (QR Code Token Lookup). All 16 backend API tests passed (some initially rate-limited, passed on retry). Frontend flow tested: login→dashboard→reservations→QR dialog→logout all working. Scan page (/scan/:qrToken) works for both valid and invalid tokens.

issues: Minor console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

context_for_next_testing_agent: M2 and M4 security features verified. Rate limiting is aggressive (5/min login, 3/min register) - if backend tests fail with 429, wait 60s and retry. Cookie auth is working with withCredentials:true in axios. QR codes contain token URLs pointing to /scan/{qr_token}.
